title: Trump Declares US Oil Independence From Hormuz; Asks Dependent Nations To Protect Critical Route
text: Trump Declares US Oil Independence From Hormuz; Asks Dependent Nations To Protect Critical RouteUS President Donald Trump, in a national address, outlined the rationale behind Operation Epic Fury, asserting that the United States no longer depends on oil imports through the Strait of Hormuz. He distanced the U.S. from responsibility for securing the critical route, despite earlier appeals to allies that were reportedly ignored. Trump claimed that the U.S. now produces more oil and gas than Saudi Arabia and Russia combined, adding that production will rise further. He emphasized that countries dependent on the Strait must take the lead in protecting it, while the U.S. would remain supportive. Trump also stated that Iran has been “completely decimated” militarily, economically, and otherwise. #timesnow #englishnews #trump #usa #hormuz #oil #iran #energy #geopolitics #world Times Now - Times Now News channel examines news with in-depth analysis.
